description:
Get comprehensive layout information for the active InDesign document. Returns page dimensions, margins, and pre-calculated content area coordinates for accurate text frame placement.

Use this BEFORE placing text frames to get correct coordinates. The contentArea bounds can be used directly for geometricBounds.

Returns:
- facingPages: whether document uses facing pages
- measurementUnits: horizontal and vertical units (use values as-is, no unit suffix needed)
- pages: array with bounds, margins, and contentArea for each page (max 20)
- contentArea accounts for page side (recto/verso) automatically
- items (when includeItems is true): each page's items with id, type, bounds, and hasGraphic — pass an id to snapshot_object to capture that item

geometricBounds format is [top, left, bottom, right].

includeItems.description: Include each page's items (id, type, bounds, hasGraphic). Use the ids with snapshot_object. Default false.

name: get_layout

facingPages.description: Whether document uses facing pages (spreads with recto/verso)

geometricBoundsFormat.description: Format reminder: geometricBounds are [top, left, bottom, right]

hasActiveDocument.description: False if no document is open in InDesign

measurementUnits.description: Document measurement units - use returned values as-is, no unit suffix needed

pageCount.description: Total number of pages in the document

pages.description: Layout info for each page (max 20 returned)

contentArea.description: Safe area for content, accounting for margins and page side. Use directly for geometricBounds

items.description: Page items (only present when includeItems is true)

bounds.description: Item geometric bounds [top, left, bottom, right]

hasGraphic.description: True if the item contains a placed graphic/image

id.description: Page item id - pass to snapshot_object to capture this item

pagesIncluded.description: Number of pages included in response (max 20)
